strings: m_c sheepishly explains to r_c0 that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} got distracted and wound up looking at the sky for too long today.

Due to m_c's lack of sleep, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'ve/'s} found that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes are more sensitive than usual, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} experiencing some temporary blindness.
In the glare of the sun, m_c hisses at it because it makes {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes burn.
m_c shakes {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head and ducks back into the den - the world outside is just particularly blinding.
